🎂 DANNY DEVITO TURNS 82 🎂
Danny DeVito was born on November 17, 1944 — 82 years ago today — and his Penguin is one of the great comic-book villains.
To mark his 82nd birthday, we're spotlighting a fan edit from the collection: Batman Returns (1992) - The Smoother Sensical Cut - CK Cut - Fan Edit.
Burton's dark Gotham Christmas, tightened up in the CK Cut.
